_comment: Tag ruleset for release tags (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules): a v* tag starts release.yml, which publishes to nuget.org through trusted publishing, so creating, moving or deleting one is reserved to repository administrators (built-in RepositoryRole 5 = Admin, bypass always).
Once immutable releases are enabled (-EnableImmutableReleases, after the draft-first release.yml is on main), GitHub also locks the tag of every published release.
name: Protect release tags
